items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence:
nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb]: 'Procurement / Contracts / HĐ-2026-0187' with Contracts as a link (Contracts); h1 'HĐ-2026-0187'; #contract-status-badge shows 'Active' text; key-fields
below header has exactly 4 fields: Vendor, Contract value, Term, Contract owner.

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: #btn-edit-contract is the single solid blue primary button ('Edit contract'); #btn-more-actions opens #more-actions-menu containing 'Duplicate contract', 'Download PDF', and 'Terminate contract'. Audit confirms headerPrimaryActions: 1.

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: renderContactsRows(): '<a href="mailto:' + c.email + '">' and '<a href="tel:' + c.phone...+ '">'; role column renders c.role; primary contact gets badge("Primary","info") text badge, e.g. Nguyễn Văn Hùng, primary: true.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: Milestones table td: 'px-3 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums' with formatAmount() (Intl.NumberFormat) under header 'Amount (VND)'; status badge column. MILESTONES array order is Overdue, Due soon, Scheduled, then Paid items — overdue/due-soon placed first.

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: badge(m.status, m.tone) renders visible text 'Overdue' and 'Due soon' inside the colored pill, e.g. MILESTONES[0].status = 'Overdue'.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: Renewal tab banner: 'notify ... by <time datetime="2026-12-01">01/12/2026</time> ... — due in 26 days'; Current term row: '01/01/2026 – 31/12/2026 (ends in 56 days)'.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: renderAmendmentsRows(): columns a.no ('PL-01'), a.date ('15/05/2026'), a.summary text, and for approved rows 'by ' + a.approvedBy + ' · ' + a.approvedDate (e.g. 'by Trần Minh Quân · 20/05/2026'); all dates are absolute dd/mm/yyyy.

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: mountContacts/mountMilestones/mountAmendments each branch on demoState: 'loading' renders skeletonRows(), 'error' renders errorRow() with a wired #retry-* button ('Retry'), 'empty' renders emptyRow()/empty markup with an action button ('Add contact', 'Add milestone').

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: #terminate-dialog: 'Terminate contract HĐ-2026-0187?' plus consequence text 'Công ty TNHH ... will be notified and the 2 remaining payment milestones (490.000.000 ₫ scheduled) will be cancelled. This cannot be undone.' Buttons: 'Keep contract' (first in DOM, no autofocus set, so default dialog focus lands here) and destructive 'Terminate contract' (verb label, red, second in tab order).

notes: Clean, restrained enterprise UI: no gradients/glass/emoji, solid Tailwind neutrals (slate/blue/amber/red/green) used semantically for status badges rather than decoratively, no uppercase tracked labels, no KPI tiles or decorative charts, radii limited to 4/6px, sidebar logo badge ('PT') is a square company mark not a circular person-avatar so it doesn't read as initials-avatar-non-person. Milestone/total amounts rely on the column header '(VND)' for currency context rather than repeating the ₫ symbol per cell (unlike the header key-fields and renewal figures, which do show '₫') — minor inconsistency but still right-aligned tabular-nums and clearly currency in context, so scored as a pass. Loading/empty/error states are only reachable via ?state= query param demo wiring, not spontaneously on first load, but the implementation (skeleton/error/empty branches with retry handlers) is present in markup and script for Contacts, Milestones and Amendments.
